label: Bears on
explanation: The opinion lists the signals of a delegation to speak with the force of law, statutory grants of rulemaking or adjudicative power and agency practice that treats its output as binding, and finds none for 10,000 unpublished letters a year from 46 offices.

sources.label: United States v. Mead Corp., 533 U.S. 218 (2001), U.S. Reports (PDF, 44 pages)
